description: Recognizes signing from an IT publisher-policy goal without certificate terminology in the request.
prompt: How do I sign Bracken Meter's Rust executable so IT's publisher rule accepts it? Cargo release works, but Windows currently shows an unknown publisher.

paraphrases.terse: Bracken Meter: unknown publisher blocks IT approval. Need Rust executable signing.
